note: The complete set of Canadian jurisdictions this section is measured against. Coverage is counted from this file and from the registry, never from a record total. blockerSummary and nextAction are internal working notes and are never rendered. Alberta is deliberately recorded as no-public-registry rather than as a blocker: the absence of a government-operated public corporate search is a researched finding about Alberta, not a fetch failure, and must never be 'resolved' by substituting a private registry agent.

jurisdictions.officialCandidateName: Alberta Corporate Registry (searches delivered by private registry agents)
jurisdictions.operator: Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction
jurisdictions.blockerSummary: Not a blocker. Alberta operates no public corporate search of its own. Alberta states "Registry agents provide all of the search services listed below" and "A registry agent will charge a government fee and a service fee to provide the information you need." There is therefore no government-operated public registry to publish.
jurisdictions.nextAction: None. Do not publish a private registry agent as though it were the government registry, and do not substitute another source. Revisit only if Alberta launches a government-operated public search.

jurisdictions.operator: BC Registry Services, Ministry of Citizens' Services
jurisdictions.blockerSummary: Published from the Province's own service description. The registry application itself is client-rendered, so access fields stay null.
jurisdictions.nextAction: In a browser, exercise the search on bcregistry.gov.bc.ca and on orgbook.gov.bc.ca, and record whether an anonymous free search exists and what it returns.

jurisdictions.operator: Companies Office, Consumer Protection Division, Government of Manitoba
jurisdictions.blockerSummary: Published from the Companies Office's own description. The transactional service presents a sign-in form, so freeToSearch stays null.
jurisdictions.nextAction: In a browser, establish whether companiesonline.gov.mb.ca offers an anonymous search path and at what cost.

jurisdictions.blockerSummary: Both www.snb.ca and www.pxw1.snb.ca returned an interstitial bot challenge on every attempt, so neither the registry's identity nor its access model could be confirmed from an official page.
jurisdictions.nextAction: Open the Corporate Affairs Registry in an ordinary desktop browser, record the official registry name, the operating department, the search URL, whether search is free and whether an account is required.

jurisdictions.blockerSummary: Service identity and register sections confirmed from the served pages. Direct requests to the company search returned the service's own error page, so access fields stay null.
jurisdictions.nextAction: In a browser, complete a company search on CADO and record the working search URL, whether it is free, and whether an account is required.

jurisdictions.operator: Registry of Joint Stock Companies, Government of Nova Scotia
jurisdictions.blockerSummary: Published from Nova Scotia's own register and search descriptions. The RJSC Connect application presented an interstitial challenge, so access fields stay null.
jurisdictions.nextAction: In a browser, exercise the search on rjsc.novascotia.ca and record the search URL, whether basic search is free and whether an account is required.

jurisdictions.operator: Department of Justice, Government of the Northwest Territories
jurisdictions.blockerSummary: Fully evidenced. The territory states basic entity information is free of charge and that a full profile requires an account with a card on file.

jurisdictions.operator: Legal Registries Division, Department of Justice, Government of Nunavut
jurisdictions.blockerSummary: Published from Nunavut's own description. No online corporate search interface was published on the division's site, which is a genuine coverage limit of the territory rather than a fetch failure.
jurisdictions.nextAction: Re-check whether Nunavut publishes an online corporate search once the division's website reconstruction is complete.

jurisdictions.operator: Ministry of Public and Business Service Delivery and Procurement
jurisdictions.blockerSummary: Fully evidenced. Ontario states anyone can search free of charge for basic information, and publishes its product prices.

jurisdictions.operator: Government of Prince Edward Island, Justice and Public Safety
jurisdictions.blockerSummary: princeedwardisland.ca is fronted by a Radware browser-verification interstitial, which was returned on every attempt, so no official page could be read.
jurisdictions.nextAction: Open the PEI corporate registry page in an ordinary desktop browser, record the official registry name, the operating department, the search URL, and whether search is free.

jurisdictions.blockerSummary: Published from Québec's own quebec.ca pages, which state the register is consulted free of charge and list the fields covered, including ultimate beneficiaries. The registre host itself returned a rate-limit refusal, so login behaviour stays null. Quebec also carries a second published record, ca-qc-rbq-licence-holders, for construction licensing.
jurisdictions.nextAction: In a browser, exercise the enterprise search and record the working deep search URL and whether any account is required.

jurisdictions.blockerSummary: Published. The entry point presents a sign-in form, so loginRequired is recorded as true from direct observation. The registry is statutory; the operator is commercial. This is NOT the Alberta case and the two must not be collapsed.
jurisdictions.nextAction: Establish from an official Government of Saskatchewan source whether any anonymous public search exists outside the ISC customer portal.

jurisdictions.blockerSummary: yukon.ca returned an interstitial bot challenge on every attempt and ycor-regcor.gov.yk.ca did not respond at all, so neither the registry's identity nor its access model could be confirmed.
jurisdictions.nextAction: Open the Yukon corporate registry in an ordinary desktop browser, record the official registry name, the search URL, whether search is free and whether an account is required.
